severity0FindingsFixed: Balance sheet, P&L splits and the entire budget column were fabricated from hardcoded ratios (cash = assets*0.15, budget = actual*0.95, variance% literal 5.3) while reading the real GL; exportable to PDF/Excel from /reports/templates.
Contra entries double-counted: Math.abs(debit-credit) made sales returns and vendor credits increase revenue and COGS.
Only 10 of 110 emitted data keys could ever render (renderer strips non-alpha chars from labels); measured 126 of 161 cells already em dashes.

ThreeStatementDashboardPage rendered every income-statement line wrong on a balanced ledger (Revenue -1150 vs 1000, COGS 0 vs 400, Gross Profit -1400 vs 600, Net Income -1650 vs 350). Causes: revenue computed debit-credit (inverse of the engine sign contract pinned in ThreeStatementEngine.test.ts), Math.abs per entry on COGS/opex/interest/tax, and the view back-solving Revenue/COGS from grossProfit/netIncome instead of using computed totals. handleExport repeated the back-solve, so exports were wrong too.
Equity omitted current-period earnings, so A = L + E could only balance at zero net income.

Cash flow was classified by account-code prefix (4/6 operating, 1 investing, 2/3 financing), conflating accrual results with cash movement. Net change is now measured on the cash account; the activity split is disclosed as not derivable rather than estimated.

TaxProvisionPage invented a four-jurisdiction ASC 740 provision (Federal 70%@21%, CA 15%@8.84%, NY 10%@6.5%, International 5%@12.5%) plus a seeded quarterly ETR and exported it. Pretax ignored COGS and used Math.abs. TaxEngine was never called.

AutoCommentaryEngine used IEEE-754 actual-budget and reported 0% when budget was zero; interpolate currency-formatted growth rates. REITDashboardPage shipped Prologis/AMT/Equinix quotes plus a mocked 5.42% yield, 10% of rent as AFFO and 1M-share NAV for every entity.

RetailDashboardPage shipped $12.4M / 6.8% / 24.2% and Flagship NYC store quotes with no GL. FinancialInstrumentsEngine still did calcPrice-price and equityValue+debtValue on floats despite claiming a full money migration.

GoalSeekPage used IEEE-754 fixed/(cm/100) and invented a $1,000,000 Monte Carlo base on an empty GL. ProjectCostingPage shipped $58.2M / 92.4% / Downtown Plaza change orders with no ledger; constructionStore persisted the same quotes as tenant defaults.

ScenarioBuilderPage fed a hardcoded $48M base into an otherwise money-safe simulator and did float Monte Carlo / save-path subtracts. UnderwritingPage shipped 96.4% adequacy and CA/FL/TX/NY filings with no ledger; insuranceStore persisted the same quotes.

CreditRiskPage invented interest as 5% of opex, years-in-business from the entity id, and EAD from currentRatio×1e6×ROA×10. ExecutiveSummary shipped $4.2M / +12% and a SaaS-bookings narrative with no GL.

BalanceSheetPage asserted Assets = Liabilities + Equity while rolling up prefixes 1/2/3 only. Because total debits equal total credits, Assets - Liabilities - PostedEquity IS net income, so the page reported "Off by <net income>" on every balanced ledger that had traded and its "Total Equity" excluded current-period earnings. Also: a 0.01 tolerance window hid a real one-cent break; the as-of filter dropped ISO-timestamped same-day entries; entries outside the 1-8 class prefixes fell out of every total undisclosed. Fixed in session 026 (src/pages/reports/balanceSheetData.ts).
